chunks: And from him, from Safwan, from al-'Ala', from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abi Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him, "May a man turn around in his salat?" He said: "No, and he must not crack his fingers."

key_terms.صَلَاتِهِ: his salat, the ritual prayer being performed
key_terms.لَا: a prohibition or negation in response to the legal question
key_terms.يَلْتَفِتُ: to turn around or look away during salat
key_terms.يَنْقُضُ: to crack or interlace and break apart the fingers' position

ai.seo_question: Is a person allowed to turn around or crack his fingers during salat?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning proper conduct in salat. It indicates that turning around during salat and cracking the fingers are not permitted acts within the prayer.
